services.desc: Lift off to the races with a 30-minute helicopter tour over the historic Saratoga Springs. Enjoy 360-degree aerial views of Saratoga Race Course, Saratoga Lake, and more. Discover the historic Saratoga Springs from the sky in a private helicopter tour over the famous Saratoga Race Course, cultural downtown district, and other sites. Book your time now and we’ll contact you within 24 hours to confirm your date, time, and customize your route. See Saratoga Springs like never before with a private helicopter tour.
